concepts.title: DNA Content Dynamics in Cell Cycle
concepts.definition: The cell cycle entails specific phases where the quantity of genetic material doubles during synthesis and returns to the original level after division.
concepts.key_idea: DNA content doubles in S-phase and halves during M-phase.
question_patterns: calculate the DNA content at G2 phase
what is the DNA amount after S phase
find the final DNA content after mitosis
how much DNA remains after M phase
calculate dna content dynamics in cell cycle for the given values

solution_steps.explain: Mitosis divides the cell into two, halving the DNA per nucleus

solution_steps.action: Validate DNA content returns to original level
solution_steps.explain: After one complete cycle of S-phase replication and M-phase division, the final DNA content per daughter cell should equal the initial G1 content.

concepts.title: Mitosis Characteristics
concepts.definition: A process of nuclear division where the parent cell produces two daughter cells with matching genetic information.
question_patterns: verify the chromosome count in daughter cells
compare parent and daughter chromosome number
what is the result of mitotic division
what do you understand by mitosis characteristics

solution_steps.explain: Mitosis ensures the progeny cells have the same chromosome count as the parent cell.
Confirm that mitosis is an equational division because the daughter chromosome number equals the parent chromosome number.
Prophase, metaphase, anaphase, and telophase sequentially segregate duplicated chromosomes, followed by cytokinesis to form two identical daughter cells.

concepts.title: Meiosis Reduction
concepts.definition: The two-step cell division that halves the chromosome number, yielding haploid gametes.
concepts.key_idea: Reduction division produces four haploid cells from one diploid cell.
question_patterns: calculate the chromosome number after meiosis
how many chromosomes are in gametes
what is the result of meiotic division
find the ploidy of daughter cells
find the required value in a meiosis reduction problem

solution_steps.explain: Meiosis reduces the chromosome count to half for sexual reproduction
Confirm the daughter chromosome number is a positive integer representing the haploid (n) state derived from the diploid (2n) parent.

solution_steps.action: Relate reduction to two meiotic divisions
solution_steps.explain: Meiosis I separates homologous chromosomes to halve ploidy, while Meiosis II separates sister chromatids equationaly, yielding four haploid gametes.
